decisive_items: Liver MRI demonstrated an occupying lesion in the right lobe with mild intrahepatic bile duct dilatation, raising the possibility of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
No extrahepatic primary tumor was identified
response.rationale: MRI explicitly suggests intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma with bile duct dilatation and elevated CA19-9, while cholecystitis is a secondary finding; gallbladder cancer lacks direct evidence.

rejected.why: Mass near gallbladder fossa is nonspecific; no clear gallbladder mass or invasion to support primary gallbladder cancer.
Cholecystitis is present but does not explain the hepatic mass and bile duct dilatation; it is a concurrent finding.
